producer: Agent Windows queue/status inventory and Odoo-local printer/Agent records

rules.owner: Remote inventory requires current active Agent ownership; missing, disconnected, inactive or stale Agent evidence gives unavailable and paginated lists use embedded owner status/lifecycle/heartbeat/threshold. Desktop's authoritative fresh local Windows observation may show actual local queue health independently of remote connectivity; it never grants remote admission.
rules.health: The displayed status is the status the Agent most recently reported from Windows, refined by its status_detail code: online -> ready (toner-low keeps ready with a toner-low label); busy -> printing; offline/error -> attention with the precise physical label (offline, paused, paper jam, out of paper, door open, no toner, manual feed, output bin full) and the generic needs-attention label only for an unspecified intervention state; unknown, unreadable, deferred or stale evidence -> unavailable; no cached probe status may be refreshed as new evidence. Operational verification is background evidence and a separate detail field; it never rewrites or masks the displayed health and it is not an admission gate for jobs: the Agent measures and caches it on its own cycle, printing falls back to the last known or configured default size when a measurement fails or is slow, and only real errors (offline or error status, retired or absent printer, offline Agent) refuse a job, each with an explicit reason
rules.details: Native status, freshness, lifecycle, transport, language, queue identity and diagnostics remain available in details; presentation does not rewrite raw health or admission
rules.inventory: Shared main/Saved views exclude sharedWithGateway=false before pagination/counting; canonical private rows and authorized by-ID/job history remain. Main otherwise contains active currently-present physical printers and Saved retains missing/inactive shared physical records. Desktop's local primary inventory retains actual private queues with independent sharing controls, without deleting or disabling the Windows queue.
rules.windows: Automatic main inventory uses named installed physical Windows queues; discovery scans remain candidates for explicit setup; manual/config/desired-owned routes are preserved. Current-account user connections remain setup-only unless Session 0 is positively established; unreadable session identity cannot authorize their shared service inventory
rules.identity: Friendly name/display aliases cannot mask actual configured or observed Windows spooler queue identity. Agent and Desktop/Odoo classify name, displayName, spoolerName and existing config/capability aliases together; endpoint/address is a queue-name fallback only for explicitly declared native spooler transport or protocol, including legacy USB+spooler. Existing driver/port/software/RDP precedence remains unchanged; real physical Canon/UNC/network queues are retained.
rules.submission: Installed-driver/GDI for document queues, RAW only for explicitly declared byte languages; transport success does not prove physical paper output. Local unshare denies new remote work after fresh admission checks, while already-admitted native work and terminal/UNKNOWN reconciliation continue.
rules.capabilityBinding: Legacy observed supported_protocols belongs to the current execution endpoint/transport/USB identity. Binding changes invalidate prior observations; name/media-only changes preserve them. Heartbeats report captured-config facts and cannot restore old-binding observations during replacement; current explicit passthrough opt-ins and document baselines remain authoritative.

dashboardAgentCounts: currentPrinterCount counts physical active present queues for cards; printerCount retains all stored registrations for management confirmations
compatibility: Existing raw-status filters and HTTP printer/job status enums remain accepted and unchanged
